Growing up, Homelander was a fan of Soldier Boy, not knowing at the time that they were father and son.

Grown from Soldier Boy's DNA and having been raised in a laboratory environment to become Homelander, John displays many sociopathic tendencies and is openly contemptuous of those he considers lesser beings.

Homelander coerced Butcher's wife into having sex with him after she had been assigned as his assistant. However, he left her alive and pregnant with his son, Ryan.

Homelander is really just a series of unpleasant urges kept in check by his own intelligence, which is enough to understand that he can have anything he wants so long as he doesn't push his luck too far.
